verdict.rationale: Daily is a real-time video/audio platform, so selective track subscription is a fair question. However, the evidence never documents an agent subscribing to just one track of a live session without publisher-side changes. The closest items describe large calls where participants receive tracks from at most 12 others, and recording of individual tracks; both are adjacent behaviors, not a selective-subscription capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent subscribes to a single track of a live broadcast without the publisher changing anything about how it publishes
